name: Amira Inbound WhatsApp
summary: Inbound WhatsApp handler: store first, then route on next_action.
description: Catch Webhook (channel webhookUrl) -> record_inbound (indexes the message, opens the 24h window, returns the lead pack) -> route: ask_channel (deterministic question / choice parsing), gather (chat assistant), stop. contact.opted_out marks the lead suppressed. Variables required: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, AgenticFlow_API_KEY, AMIRA_CHAT_ASSISTANT_ID.
author: amira
